title: Ordering food and drinks
summary: Order a dish, ask for a recommendation, handle a sold-out dish or a dietary need, then pick a drink.

order.speaker: Waiter
order.en: What would you like to order?

variants.en: What would you like to eat?

variants.zh: 好的，请坐。请问您想点什么？
variants.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng zuò. Qǐngwèn nín xiǎng diǎn shénme?
variants.en: Please have a seat. What would you like to order?

rephrase.zh: 您决定好要吃什么了吗？
rephrase.pinyin: Nín juédìng hǎo yào chī shénme le ma?
rephrase.en: Have you decided what you'd like to eat?

choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào yì wǎn miàntiáo.
choices.en: I would like a bowl of noodles

choices.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi xiǎng hǎo, zài děng yíxià.

spicy.speaker: Waiter
spicy.zh: 好的。要辣的还是不辣的？
spicy.pinyin: Hǎo de. Yào là de háishi bú là de?

rephrase.pinyin: Miàntiáo lǐ yào bu yào fàng làjiāo?
rephrase.en: Do you want chili in the noodles?

rice-soldout.speaker: Waiter
rice-soldout.zh: 不好意思，炒饭今天卖完了。换成面条可以吗？
rice-soldout.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, chǎofàn jīntiān mài wán le. Huàn chéng miàntiáo kěyǐ ma?
rice-soldout.en: Sorry, the fried rice is sold out today. Would noodles work instead?

rephrase.zh: 炒饭已经没有了，您想不想试试面条？
rephrase.pinyin: Chǎofàn yǐjīng méiyǒu le, nín xiǎng bu xiǎng shìshi miàntiáo?
rephrase.en: The fried rice is gone — would you like to try the noodles?

choices.pinyin: Nà yǒu shénme bié de ma?
choices.en: What else do you have, then?
Then I'll look at the menu again

recommend.speaker: Waiter
recommend.zh: 我们的招牌菜是红烧肉。
recommend.pinyin: Wǒmen de zhāopái cài shì hóngshāoròu.

rephrase.zh: 很多客人都点红烧肉，这是我们最有名的菜。
rephrase.pinyin: Hěn duō kèrén dōu diǎn hóngshāoròu, zhè shì wǒmen zuì yǒumíng de cài.
rephrase.en: Lots of customers order the braised pork; it's our most famous dish.

choices.pinyin: Wǒ bù chī zhūròu, yǒu sùcài ma?
choices.en: I don't eat pork — do you have vegetable dishes?
Thanks, let me look some more

pork-spicy.speaker: Waiter
pork-spicy.en: It's not spicy — it's a little sweet.

choices.en: Thanks, let me look some more

dietary.speaker: Waiter
dietary.zh: 有，炒青菜和地三鲜都是素的。
dietary.pinyin: Yǒu, chǎo qīngcài hé dìsānxiān dōu shì sù de.
dietary.en: Yes — the stir-fried greens and the potato, eggplant and pepper dish are both vegetarian.

rephrase.zh: 有不放肉的菜，比如炒青菜。
rephrase.pinyin: Yǒu bú fàng ròu de cài, bǐrú chǎo qīngcài.
rephrase.en: We have dishes without meat, like stir-fried greens.

choices.pinyin: Nà jiù yào yí fèn chǎo qīngcài.

choices.zh: 我对花生过敏，里面有花生吗？
choices.pinyin: Wǒ duì huāshēng guòmǐn, lǐmiàn yǒu huāshēng ma?
choices.en: I'm allergic to peanuts — is there peanut in it?

allergy.speaker: Waiter
allergy.zh: 没有花生。我跟厨房说一下，不放花生油。
allergy.pinyin: Méiyǒu huāshēng. Wǒ gēn chúfáng shuō yíxià, bú fàng huāshēng yóu.
allergy.en: No peanuts. I'll tell the kitchen not to use peanut oil.

drink.speaker: Waiter
drink.pinyin: Hǎo de. Yào hē diǎn shénme ma?

choices.pinyin: Yì bēi wēn shuǐ jiù hǎo.
choices.en: Just a glass of warm water

order-end.speaker: Waiter
order-end.pinyin: Hǎo de, mǎshàng lái. Qǐng shāo děng!
order-end.en: Coming right up. Please wait a moment!

beer-end.speaker: Waiter
beer-end.zh: 有，青岛啤酒，冰的。马上给您拿。
beer-end.pinyin: Yǒu, Qīngdǎo píjiǔ, bīng de. Mǎshàng gěi nín ná.
beer-end.en: Yes — cold Tsingtao. I'll bring it right away.
beer-end.outcome: Your order is placed with a cold beer.

minute-end.speaker: Waiter
minute-end.zh: 没问题，您慢慢看，好了叫我。
minute-end.pinyin: Méi wèntí, nín mànman kàn, hǎo le jiào wǒ.
minute-end.en: No problem. Take your time and call me when you're ready.
minute-end.outcome: The waiter gives you more time.

more-end.speaker: Waiter
more-end.zh: 好的，您慢慢看。需要时请叫我。
more-end.pinyin: Hǎo de, nín mànman kàn. Xūyào shí qǐng jiào wǒ.
more-end.en: Take your time. Please call me when you are ready.
more-end.outcome: You keep looking at the menu.
